rule.name: peecare_development_telemetry
rule.description: Forward canonical PeeCare development telemetry to the ingestion webhook.
rule.sql:
SELECT
  topic,
  clientid AS clientId,
  username,
  qos,
  flags.retain AS retained,
  publish_received_at AS brokerReceivedAtMs,
  json_decode(payload) AS payload
FROM "products/+/devices/+/events/urination",
  "products/+/devices/+/status/battery"

connector.name: {{PEECARE_EMQX_CONNECTOR_NAME}}
connector.description: Connect to the approved development Cloud Run ingestion origin.

action.name: {{PEECARE_EMQX_ACTION_NAME}}
action.description: POST the fixed PeeCare event envelope to development Cloud Run.
